entities.summary: Romana Jordan is a Slovenian politician and physicist. She serves as the Assistant Director for EU Affairs at the Jožef Stefan Institute. She was elected as a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) in 2004-2014, during which she sat on the European Parliament's Committee on Industry, Research and Energy. She is a member of the Slovenian Democratic Party, which is part of the European People's Party.
